decks.notes: The deck is focused on aggressive playstyle with Ghyrson Starn, Kelermorph as the commander. The deck includes a variety of low-cost spells like Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Forked Bolt to quickly damage opponents. It also includes counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce to protect its creatures while maintaining pressure on the opponent. The deck features a mix of flying creatures like Faerie Seer and Spectral Sailor, along with prowess creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Young Pyromancer for additional damage. The mana base is designed to support the low-cost spells with fetch lands and dual lands for consistency. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast, aggressive creatures and burn spells for efficient removal.

This deck revolves around assembling a powerful combination of cards that work together to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategies while setting up for a game-winning play. It includes a mix of powerful creatures, removal spells, and tutors to find key combo pieces. The commander, The Beamtown Bullies, provides a strong creature base and synergizes with the rest of the deck to create a dominating presence on the battlefield. By efficiently managing resources and strategically deploying threats, this deck aims to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory through a well-executed combo sequence. The deck's main objective is to overwhelm opponents with its powerful synergies and game-winning combos while disrupting their game plan and maintaining control of the board.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing the Partner commanders Tana and Yoshimaru to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm the opponent. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal spells, and powerful equipment, the goal is to apply pressure early on and maintain it throughout the game. The deck includes a variety of versatile cards that can help control the board or push through damage, such as Lightning Bolt, Swords to Plowshares, and Skyclave Apparition. By combining the aggressive nature of aggro strategies with the flexibility of the WRG color combination, this deck aims to outpace opponents and secure victories through swift and decisive combat.

This deck focuses on aggressive strategies by utilizing a combination of red, white, and green cards, with Tana, the Bloodsower and Yoshimaru, Ever Faithful as the commanders. The deck includes a mix of early-game threats like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar and Bonecrusher Giant, along with disruption spells like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Drannith Magistrate to disrupt opponents' game plans. The deck also includes powerful equipment like Skullclamp and Swords to Plowshares to enhance the creatures' abilities and provide additional removal options. With a strong mana base and a variety of powerful creatures and spells, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with aggressive plays and versatile threats.
